fullPassage: When fish in a school face a threat, the way they make swift and seemingly choreographed turns, darts, or zigzags gives the impression of a single, cohesive entity evading the perceived danger. But how can the school of fish ―sometimes comprising hundreds or even thousands of individuals― coordinate so quickly and seamlessly? It turns out that in high-risk waters, fish swim close together. In close quarters, fish are more sensitive to their immediate environment. As a result, when some fish detect a predator and suddenly swim away, the nearby fish mimic their movement instantly. This triggers a chain reaction throughout the school, and all the fish move as one. Their collective behavior offers clear benefits; fish can stay safe from the predator without having to directly detect it with their own senses. Being able to sense a threat through their neighbors allows them to respond much faster than if they were isolated, providing them more time to escape and thereby improving their chances of survival.

But how can the school of fish ―sometimes comprising hundreds or even thousands of individuals― coordinate so quickly and seamlessly? It turns out that in high-risk waters, fish swim close together. In close quarters, fish are more sensitive to their immediate environment. As a result, when some fish detect a predator and suddenly swim away, the nearby fish mimic their movement instantly. This triggers a chain reaction throughout the school, and all the fish move as one. Their collective behavior offers clear benefits; fish can stay safe from the predator without having to directly detect it with their own senses. Being able to sense a threat through their neighbors allows them to respond much faster than if they were isolated, providing them more time to escape and thereby improving their chances of survival.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 [조건]에 주어진 단어를 모두 사용하여 빈칸에 알맞은 영어를 쓰시오. (영어로) (그것은) 그들에게 도망갈 시간을 더 벌어 주면서. Being able to sense a threat through their neighbors allows them to respond much faster than if they were isolated, ______________________ and thereby improving their chances of survival. (6단어)
[조건] (1) escape, more, providing, them, time, to를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 분사구문 providing + them(대상) + more time + to escape(꾸미는 to부정사)
det.analysis:
'~해 주면서'라는 분사구문은 providing으로 시작해요. '그들에게 더 많은 시간을'은 them + more time 순서로 놓아요(provide A B = A에게 B를 주다). '도망갈 (시간)'은 앞의 time을 꾸미는 to부정사 to escape로 마무리해요
→ providing + them + more + time + to + escape
동사원형 provide가 아니라 분사 providing으로 시작해야 앞 절을 부연하는 분사구문이 돼요
det.tip: 분사구문 providing + them(대상) + more time + to escape(꾸미는 to부정사)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 명사 danger(위험)를 앞에서 꾸미며 '감지된'이라는 수동의 의미이므로 과거분사 perceived로 써야 함
det.analysis:
빈칸은 뒤의 명사 danger(위험)를 앞에서 꾸미는 형용사 자리예요. 위험은 물고기에게 '감지되는' 대상이므로 수동의 뜻을 지닌 과거분사 perceived(감지된)로 바꿔야 해요
→ the perceived danger(감지된 위험)
동사원형 perceive를 그대로 두면 명사를 꾸미는 형용사 자리에 맞지 않아요
det.tip: 명사를 앞에서 꾸미며 '~된(수동)'이면 과거분사(p.p.). perceive → perceived
